title: haworthiopsis × tortuosa
intro: Haworthiopsis × tortuosa, commonly known as the Twist-Leaf Haworthia, is a hybrid succulent plant resulting from the cross between Haworthia fasciata and Haworthia limifolia. This plant is valued for its unique twisted leaves, which are known to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving air quality. The therapeutic actions of Haworthiopsis × tortuosa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
